conviction_note: Only one small leg-2 finding (the 6 of 9 covering analysts who had not published by 09-22 publishing overnight, -0.8) and no leg-1 overshoot with a mechanism; I nudged it to -1.0 because the 25x volume cut (>15x: -2.44% next session) and the 8.2% ATR agree with the sign, and held it well short of that because this name's own four comparable falls bounced 3 of 4 times (median +3.65%, but all were earnings/guidance falls, not an accounting probe).
bar: No earnings bar exists (results withdrawn from the usual calendar, due by 2026-11-02). Sized against the baseline's own-fall history (n=4, median |next| 5.35%) and the indicative option straddle (24.82% over 24 days, ATM spread 67% of mid, so indicative only); the cause document is the 6-K at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1656081/000119312526396797/d240370dex991.htm

cause.label: management_or_governance
cause.what_happened: At 17:06 ET on 2026-09-21 (after the close) Endava filed a 6-K saying the board had placed CFO Mark Thurston on administrative leave pending an Audit Committee investigation, run by independent outside counsel, into auditor concerns about the accounting treatment of certain customer and supplier agreements. It named an AlixPartners interim CFO and pushed FY26 results and the 20-F to 'a later timetable' by 2026-11-02. The stock fell about 10-12% after hours, gapped -14.3% and lost another 11.5% intraday on 25x volume while law-firm solicitations and a William Blair downgrade ran on the wires.

evidence.claim: 6-K accepted 2026-09-21 17:06:57; CFO on administrative leave, investigation over auditor concerns, interim CFO from AlixPartners, FY26 results/20-F delayed to by Nov 2, 2026
Press release (Ex 99.1): scope limited to 'accounting treatment of certain customer and supplier agreements and related matters'; no non-reliance language, no guidance or liquidity statement
Announcement at 5:11 PM ET, stock down 10% after hours
William Blair downgrade to Underperform from Market Perform, citing the investigation and CFO transition
Block & Leviton securities-fraud investigation solicitation (not a filed suit)

pipeline.next_dated_event: Nothing company-dated inside the window. Pending analyst notes from the 6 of 9 covering brokers not yet heard from, expected overnight 09-22/09-23 but undated. FINRA's 09-15 short-interest settlement publishes 2026-09-24 (outside). FY26 results and 20-F are due by 2026-11-02 (outside).
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An overnight company statement narrowing the investigation's scope (for example 'no impact on revenue' or 'no restatement expected'), or several brokers reiterating with targets above spot, would flip the sign. A non-reliance filing or an RCF default notice would make -1.0 far too small.

positioning_check: Short interest 1,421,527 shares at the 2026-08-31 settlement (-23,713 vs prior), 6.94 days to cover (Equibles, citing FINRA: https://equibles.com/stocks/dava/short-interest). That is about 2.7% of ~53m ADS, derived from a ~$148m cap at $2.80 (https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/nebenwerte/endava-stock-falls-as-accounting-investigation-reshapes-guidance/70151288). The position carried into the fall is not observable: the 09-15 settlement publishes 09-24, outside the window. Nasdaq's short-interest API returned 503 from here. Options: the 25-delta skew was not computable (null). Put/call OI 0.52 on 1,488 contracts total, ATM IV 86.7% with a 67% spread, so the chain carries no usable directional read.

findings.finding: By the aggregator's count only 3 of 9 covering analysts had acted by 2026-09-22: William Blair to Underperform, Deutsche Bank cut its target from $3.00 to $2.00 at Hold, TD Cowen reaffirmed Hold at $3.50. The rest are likely to publish downgrades, 'under review' ratings or target cuts before the 2026-09-23 open.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Brokers usually publish within one or two sessions of a CFO-leave/accounting-probe disclosure. The six that had not published on the drop day would most likely do so on the morning of 09-23, inside the window, rather than later. Without results or numbers to wait for, a delay has no reason, so the remaining notes land now or not at all.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not measurable from the baseline: none of the 4 comparable falls (2024-02-29, 2025-05-14, 2025-09-04, 2025-11-11) was an accounting probe. Those were results-day falls, where the analyst wave arrives on the drop day itself, and they bounced 3 of 4 times the next session. Here the one reiteration (TD Cowen $3.50) and the $2.00 DB target sit above or near spot, so the wave so far is mixed and not uniformly bearish.
findings.why_not_priced: The drop-day tape priced the event and three notes. It has not taken the rest of the coverage, and at a consensus 'Reduce' with 5 Holds and a $5.36 average target the likeliest next moves are downgrades or suspensions, not defences. If the price held them, the intraday leg would have flattened into the close. Instead it fell another 11.5% after the gap on 25x volume, with no sign that selling had run out by 15:05.
findings.independence: The William Blair downgrade is confirmed separately by Investing.com at 06:48 ET on 09-22 (https://www.investing.com/news/analyst-ratings/endava-stock-rating-cut-to-underperform-by-william-blair-on-cfo-exit-93CH-4910377). Nothing independent shows the remaining six are due overnight; that part rests on the typical publishing lag.

outside_window.finding: FY26 Q4/full-year results and 20-F are delayed and promised by the SEC deadline of 2026-11-02. The investigation's findings, including any non-reliance or restatement (Item 4.02-type), land then or earlier on an undated 6-K. This is the real second shoe, and it is not dated inside the window.

Leverage against equity: borrowings £195.8m against cash £48.4m at 2026-03-31, i.e. net debt of roughly £147m (about $195m) against a market cap now near $115m. Adjusted PBT was £3.2m in Q3 FY26. The Dec-2025 interim says 'no covenant breaches are expected' under the RCF. A delayed audited-accounts delivery or a restated EBITDA could engage the RCF's reporting or financial covenants, but no test or delivery date was found inside the window.
Securities class action: law firms (Block & Leviton, Glancy Prongay) are soliciting, but no complaint is filed yet. A filing would be undated and largely expected.
FINRA short-interest settlement of 2026-09-15 publishes 2026-09-24, one day after the window closes.

searched_and_found_nothing: Leg-1 overshoot mechanism: the primary 6-K and Ex 99.1 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1656081/000119312526396797/d240370dex991.htm) match the wire headlines. There is no non-reliance language and no guidance, so there is no headline-versus-document gap for an overnight reader to close.

Disclosed buyer: $28.1m of buyback authorisation was left at 2026-03-31 (Q3 FY26 release), but no purchase can be assumed while an accounting investigation is open. No Form 4 buys since 2026-07-02 (EDGAR submissions); Nasdaq insider summary shows 0 buys and 4 sells over 3 months.
Company releases after 09-21: investors.endava.com press-release list shows nothing after the 2026-09-21 interim CFO release (https://investors.endava.com/news-events/press-releases).

Scheduled event on 2026-09-23: none found (web search 'Endava Sept 23 2026'). The baseline's next_earnings_estimated of 2026-09-24 is a Zacks cadence prior and is now void, because the company itself deferred results to by 2026-11-02.
RCF covenant waiver: a search returned a 'conditional waiver' exhibit under CIK 1747079, a different issuer, which is not Endava and was discarded. No Endava waiver or amendment was found.
Listing risk: NYSE ADS at $2.115, no 'minimum bid price' hits in EDGAR full text (baseline probe), no ATM ('at-the-market' 0 hits ever), no going-concern language (0 hits).
EDGAR full-text search (efts.sec.gov) for 'covenant' returned HTTP 500. I used the 2026-03-30 interim 6-K text instead.
Nasdaq short-interest API returned HTTP 503. I used the Equibles FINRA-derived figure instead.

Contamination: some aggregator pages (stockobserver, ad-hoc-news) carried drop-day market-cap and 52-week-range figures whose timestamp relative to 15:05 ET is unclear. Those price-derived figures were excluded from reasoning, apart from the pre-drop $2.80 reference used to derive the share count.
baseline_tension: The findings agree with the 25x volume and the high ATR (continuation) and cut against this name's own history of comparable falls (3 of 4 up next day, median +3.65%). That history comes from earnings-day falls, not an unresolved accounting probe, so I gave it partial weight: -1.0 sits between the -2.44% heavy-volume conditional and the +3.65% own-history median, closer to the research read of -0.8.
